topics.headline: superlative predicate requiring domain and specification
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the word is incomplete until the comparison field and the tamyīz arrive.
topics.reason: It is the accusative predicate of kāna and governs the following comparison-domain and specification structure.

topics.headline: abundance turned into argumentative excess
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the root of increase becomes a diagnosis of overabundant disputation.
topics.reason: The broad k-th-r field is narrowed locally to superlative excess in jadal, with abundance and rivalry pressure retained.

topics.headline: afʿal ranked form
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices ranking, not simple quantity.
topics.reason: The comparative-superlative form differs from a verb of doing much or a simple adjective meaning many.

topics.headline: surah excess and totality pairing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices two scales facing each other: complete provision and maximal disputation, with 18:34 as an earlier excess echo.
topics.reason: Rows link this word to the earlier garden-owner boast at 18:34 and to the local kull versus akthar scale.

words.gloss_range: indefinite genitive comparison-domain noun widening the superlative field to any thing or entity
words.prose: {{ar:شَىْءٍ}} ({{tr:shayʾin}}) widens the superlative beyond a human-only comparison. It is governed by {{ar:أَكْثَرَ}} ({{tr:akthara}}) as the comparison domain, and its indefinite singular form stretches the field to any entity or matter before {{ar:جَدَلًا}} ({{tr:jadalan}}) finally specifies the respect. The will-and-thing root pressure is useful only as breadth: it enlarges the domain without changing the grammar into a theology of will.
words.root_gloss_range: thing, entity, matter, and what may be willed or conceived; locally selects the broad comparison domain

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: superlative governor of the comparison-domain noun

topics.headline: comparison domain governed by the superlative
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the human is ranked against the widest field, not merely against other people.
topics.reason: The noun is genitive after the superlative and functions as comparison complement, not agent or patient.

topics.headline: maximally broad thing-entity field
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the comparison field expanding to whatever can count as a thing or entity.
topics.reason: The root-family link to willing is retained as breadth pressure while local grammar keeps the word as domain noun.

topics.headline: singular indefinite and glottal pause
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the broad domain held open, then audibly checked before the final specification.
topics.reason: The singular indefinite generalizes, and the hamza creates a sound break before the closing noun.

topics.headline: totality bridge between parable and diagnosis
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the first beat’s every-example scope answered by the second beat’s everything-domain comparison.
topics.reason: Rows connect this word with kull, mathal, same-surah totality references such as 18:45, and the tanwīn thread into the final word.

words.gloss_range: accusative indefinite specification naming argumentativeness as the respect in which the human is ranked most
words.prose: {{ar:جَدَلًا}} ({{tr:jadalan}}) is the final diagnostic landing. It completes the superlative by stating the respect: not knowledge or strength, but argumentativeness. The root’s twisting and plaiting image makes the response feel like braided contention against diversified examples, while the noun form names a disposition before 18:56 enacts the same root as disputing action. Its exact noun form is distributionally rare, with 43:58 as the cited cross-reference, and its final position, stop-liquid texture, and tanwīn cadence make divine turning and human twisting meet at the ayah’s close.
words.root_gloss_range: disputation, dialectic, twisting, plaiting, and reciprocal contest; locally selects problematic argumentative twisting after explanation

topics.headline: final tamyīz specification
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices exactly in what respect the human is most: argumentation.
topics.reason: The word is accusative specification after the superlative phrase and completes the predicate chain.

topics.headline: twisting argument as contentious disposition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices disputation as verbal twisting and entanglement, not just neutral discussion.
topics.reason: The root field includes twisting, plaiting, and reciprocal disputation; local contrast with Quranic variation selects the problematic sense while leaving formal dialectic as a narrowed range note.

topics.headline: abstract noun and emphatic closure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a trait named as a quality, with final sound weight and rarity reinforcing closure.
topics.reason: The accusative indefinite noun names a disposition rather than a finite event; tanwīn and stop-liquid texture close the ayah.

topics.headline: diagnosis enacted forward and framed backward
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the final word looking back to 18:53 and forward to 18:56 while opposing divine turning with human twisting.
topics.reason: Rows connect the word to 18:53 boundary diagnosis, to the same-root disputing verb at 18:56, to 58:1 as a broader disputation field, and to the ṣ-r-f versus j-d-l frame.
